SELECT 
  category AS "프로젝트 ID",
  category AS "프로젝트명",
  TO_CHAR(MIN(created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "최초 등록일",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, '') != 'placeholder') || '건' AS "등록 문서 수"
FROM graphrag.graphrag_sources
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY MIN(created_at) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT id, email, name, role_id, department, approval_status
FROM graphrag.admin_users
ORDER BY created_at DESC
